newsitem.title: USA: Nike recalls shoes that offend Muslims.
newsitem.headline: Nike recalls shoes that offend Muslims.

text.p: Nike Inc on Tuesday recalled more than 38,000 pairs of athletic shoes with a logo that outraged the Muslim community.
A spokeseman for the Beaverton, Ore.-based athletic apparel giant said the shoes sparked protests because the flame logo looked like the Arabic word for Allah (God).

"There is in excess of 38,000 pairs in our distribution centers worldwide that we'll be recalling, and we'll obliterate the logo before reintroducing it...through our retail chain," said Nike spokesman Roy Agostino.
"Through a long process of discussions we have resolved our differences of opinion with the Muslim community," the company said in a statement.

"While we never intended to offend - we did. We have done everything possible to communicate our sincerest apologies and to address issues related to the distribution of any products offensive to the community," it said.
